intent: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation entry point. Use WebTestClient bound to the controller with a mocked IngestTelemetryUseCase. POST /api/v1/telemetry/ingress with Content-Type application/x-ndjson and a body of one JSON sample document per line (streamed Flux<TelemetrySample> = streamed documents, not one array) responds 200 with the use case count as JSON number; the X-Request-Id header value is passed as correlationId, and a generated non-blank UUID is passed when absent.

methods.signature: public Mono<Long> ingest(Flux<TelemetrySample> samples, String requestId)
